name: PaddleOCR
tagline: Lightweight multilingual OCR toolkit supporting 80+ languages, table recognition, and fast CPU deployment.
real_test_summary: Tested extracting text and structured tables from scanned receipts and multi-language documents on CPU. Ultra-compact mobile models run fast without a dedicated graphics card.
pros: Ultra-lightweight models run accurately on CPU with minimal RAM
Supports over 80 languages plus table structure and key-value extraction
Apache-2.0 license with CLI, Python API, and ONNX export support
cons: PaddlePaddle framework installation can be heavier than pure ONNX tools
Complex multi-column layouts require tuning detection thresholds
